_about: Quick facts on each lake home page, written into the HTML by tools/build-lake-pages.py (no JavaScript). Every line is copied from text the site already sources (water.html lake facts cards, the home page map notes and How to read this, js/lake-map-data-*.js); the gauge link comes from js/lakes.js. Leave a field out when there is no official source. checked = the date the facts were last checked against the sources listed; it also becomes the page's WebPage dateModified.

hoover.motors: 10 hp limit and 10 mph; idle speed within 100 ft of shore. Boats 22 ft max.
hoover.ramps: Five public ramps: Oxbow Road, Sunbury Road, Twin Bridges, Red Bank and Walnut Street. Shore access on the Mudflats Boardwalk.
hoover.pool: Summer pool is 894 ft, the level the ODNR contour map is drawn at.
hoover.night: City park hours are 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.; check posted signs before a night trip.
sources: Columbus Recreation and Parks, Hoover Reservoir

alum.motors: Unlimited horsepower on the south main lake, no wake on the north end. The state park puts the line at US 36/SR 37, the Corps at Cheshire Road, so follow the buoys.
alum.ramps: Four public launch ramps: New Galena, the marina ramp on Hollenback Road, Cheshire and Howard. One more for campers.
alum.pool: Summer pool is 888 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
sources: US Army Corps of Engineers, Alum Creek Lake

buckeye.motors: No horsepower limit. No wake within 300 ft of any land mass and in marked areas.
buckeye.ramps: North Shore, Liebs Island and Fairfield Beach ramps, plus the Mud Island fishing access.
buckeye.pool: Normal summer pool is 891.75 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.

oshaughnessy.motors: Unlimited horsepower; 40 mph by day. Idle speed within 100 ft of shore and bridges. Boats 22 ft or shorter, no personal watercraft.
oshaughnessy.ramps: Home Road ramp and marina, and the Bellepoint ramp. Canoe and kayak launches at Twin Lakes and on the east side.
oshaughnessy.pool: Full pool is the City dam crest, 848.5 ft. ODNR fishing map depths are based on 847.9 ft.
oshaughnessy.night: 10 mph from sunset to sunrise (City code). City park hours are 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.; check posted signs before a night trip.
sources: Columbus Recreation and Parks, O’Shaughnessy Reservoir

griggs.motors: Unlimited horsepower; 40 mph by day. Idle speed within 100 ft of shore and bridges. Boats 22 ft or shorter, no personal watercraft.
griggs.ramps: Griggs boat launch south of Fishinger Road, plus the marina and public boat docks.
griggs.pool: Full pool is the City dam crest, 756.18 ft. ODNR fishing map depths are based on 757 ft.
griggs.night: 10 mph from sunset to sunrise (City code). City park hours are 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.; check posted signs before a night trip.
sources: Columbus Recreation and Parks, Griggs Park

indian.motors: No horsepower limit. No wake within 300 ft of any shoreline, in channels and where marked.
indian.ramps: Five state park launch ramps: Moundwood, Lakeview Harbor, Blackhawk, Chippewa and Cranetown Island. Fishing jetties at Old Field Beach.
indian.pool: Normal summer pool is 996.3 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
indian.night: State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.

delaware.motors: Unlimited horsepower. Follow the posted no wake buoys.
delaware.ramps: Three state park ramps: the main marina ramp, Sherwood Road on the east side and the southwest launch area.
delaware.pool: Normal summer pool is 915 ft. ODNR lists a winter drawdown to about 910 ft.
delaware.night: State park hours are sunrise to sunset; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.

deercreek.ramps: Two state park ramps and a marina. Shore access below the dam.
deercreek.pool: Summer pool is 810.5 ft on the ODNR fishing map. ODNR lists a winter drawdown to about 796 ft.
deercreek.night: State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.
sources: ODNR, Deer Creek Lake Fishing Area

madison.motors: Electric motors only, at no wake speed.
madison.ramps: One launch ramp, with shore fishing by it.
madison.pool: Summer pool is 965 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
madison.night: State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.

knox.motors: 10 hp limit; larger motors at no wake or idle only.
knox.ramps: Marina and main ramp on Armentrout Road and an upper lake ramp. Carry-in access on the east side.
knox.pool: Summer pool is 1,100 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.

clearfork.motors: No horsepower limit, but idle speed and no wake on the whole lake (City code). ODNR’s page says 8 mph.
clearfork.ramps: Free public ramp and marina on the south side. Shore fishing on the south and west shores only.
clearfork.pool: Summer pool is 1,202 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
clearfork.night: City code bars parking from dark to dawn outside designated camping areas, so check posted City signs before a night trip.
sources: City of Mansfield, Clearfork Reservoir Park
ODNR, Clear Fork Reservoir Fishing Area

seneca.motors: 399 hp limit. Idle or no wake inside the buoyed and shore zones.
seneca.ramps: MWCD lists five public launch ramps, plus the Seneca Lake Marina.
seneca.pool: Summer pool is 832 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
seneca.night: MWCD areas close from 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. except to people fishing, hunting or boating.

dillon.motors: Unlimited horsepower; many coves are no wake.
dillon.ramps: Two state park ramps at the south end: the marina ramp and Big Run.
dillon.pool: Summer pool is 737 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
dillon.night: State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.

logan.ramps: Main ramp and marina off Lake Logan Road, and a smaller ramp about 1.5 miles northeast.
logan.pool: Summer pool is 759 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
logan.night: State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.

saltfork.motors: Unlimited horsepower, with marked speed and ski zones.
saltfork.ramps: ODNR’s fishing page counts 10 ramps and the park page names 8, including Sugartree Marina and Morning Glory. Two marinas.
saltfork.pool: Summer pool is 800 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
saltfork.night: State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.
sources: ODNR, Salt Fork Lake Fishing Area

burroak.motors: 10 hp limit; larger motors at idle only, no jet drives.
burroak.ramps: Four ramps: Dock 1 with the marina, Dock 3, Dock 4 and the Lodge ramp.
burroak.pool: Summer pool is 721 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
burroak.night: State park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.
sources: ODNR, Burr Oak Lake Fishing Area

dow.ramps: One ramp off Strouds Run Road, with a courtesy dock. Shore fishing by the dam.
dow.pool: Summer pool is 660 ft, the level the ODNR fishing map is drawn at.
dow.night: Strouds Run State Park hours are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; ODNR allows legitimate recreation, like fishing, outside those hours.
